description: This file defines the GrainBasedPubSubRuntime class implementing the IStreamPubSub interface, managing pub/sub interactions within the Orleans streaming infrastructure. It handles registration and deregistration of producers and consumers, counts, subscription retrieval, and fault handling for stream-based pub/sub using grains.

classes.name: GrainBasedPubSubRuntime
classes.description: Implements pub/sub runtime logic for streams in Orleans, managing producer/consumer registration, counts, and subscription retrieval via grains.

methods.name: RegisterProducer
methods.description: Registers a producer for a specific stream.

methods.name: UnregisterProducer
methods.description: Unregisters a producer from a stream.

methods.name: RegisterConsumer
methods.description: Registers a consumer with specific filters for a stream.

methods.name: UnregisterConsumer
methods.description: Unregisters a consumer from a stream.

methods.name: ProducerCount
methods.description: Returns the number of producers for a stream.

methods.name: ConsumerCount
methods.description: Returns the number of consumers for a stream.

methods.name: GetAllSubscriptions
methods.description: Retrieves all subscriptions for a stream, optionally filtered by consumer.

methods.name: CreateSubscriptionId
methods.description: Creates a new subscription ID for a consumer in a stream.
